Class NinePatchRectDrawing

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Geometry.RectDef

Provides extension methods for drawing a NinePatchRect as filled rectangles or outlined rectangles.

Remarks

The drawing helpers iterate over the generated patch rectangles exposed by Rects and optionally render the original source rectangle exposed by Source using separate styling.
